title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 24, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 23, 2026 at 06:30 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 314 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)

The Sun will eventually swell into a red giant, likely engulfing Mercury and Venus — and possibly Earth. 🖤🌞

A broad coronal-hole region stands out in today’s solar imagery, alongside several bright active regions and only a few small sunspots.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
